verdict.rationale: Skyfire bounds agent spending per pay token: the committed amount is a hard ceiling, charges above the remaining balance are rejected, and tokens expire between 10 seconds and 24 hours. Deactivation stops new token creation, but in-flight tokens stay chargeable until expiry plus a 24-hour grace period, so revocation is not instant. API keys are scoped to a single agent, but no configurable per-agent spend cap or usage limit is documented. missing for 10: configurable per-agent spend caps and usage limits, instant revocation of outstanding tokens or a per-token revocation API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set per-agent spend caps and usage limits and revoke an agent's payment authority instantly

citations.quote: Charges above the token's remaining balance are rejected.
New token creation stops at deactivation, but in-flight tokens are honored so sellers are paid for services they were legitimately asked to deliver.
each key is scoped to a single agent (Buyer or Seller)
